brief:
Democratic leaders issued criticism of Palestinian journalist Rula Jebreal over bigoted remarks she had previously apologized for, according to Zeteo. The party's response to Jebreal's statements stood in marked contrast to its public silence regarding seven right-wing figures who made comparable bigoted comments during the same period.

Party officials faced accusations of applying unequal standards in addressing racist speech. Critics pointed to the selective condemnation as evidence that Democratic responses to bigotry depended significantly on the speaker's political alignment and background rather than the nature of the remarks themselves, Zeteo reported.
dek: Seven right-wing bigots have said bigoted things in recent weeks and top Dems have said... nothing, even as they piled on against a Palestinian journalist who apologized for her own bigoted remarks.
title: Democrats condemn Palestinian journalist while ignoring right-wing bigotry
